help_section_playback_value:
`/play <query>` - Play / queue song from YouTube/Spotify
`/pause` - Pause song
`/resume` - Resume song
`/skip` - Skip to next song
`/previous` - Play previous song
`/stop` - Stop & clear queue
help_section_queue_value:
`/queue` - View paginated queue list
`/nowplaying` (`/np`) - View current song
`/shuffle` - Shuffle queue
`/collection save <name>` - Save queue to SQLite collection
`/collection load <name>` - Load collection into queue
help_section_info_value:
`/favorite` - Add current song to favorites
`/favorites` - List favorite songs
`/stats` - Performance & system metrics
`/ping` - Check latency
help_footer: aetrna-music v2.0 • Ultra-fast Go Music Engine
stats_owner_only: ❌ This command can only be used by the Bot Owner!
ytauth_description: If YouTube blocks 18+ (Age-Restricted) videos or your VPS IP, install `cookies.txt` on the server:
ytauth_step1_value: Install Chrome/Firefox extension **'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY'** and export YouTube cookies from a throwaway account.
ytauth_step2_value: Save the exported file as `cookies.txt` in the bot's project root folder (`%s`).
ytauth_step3_value: Restart the bot. Audio stream engine will auto-detect and use `cookies.txt` to bypass age checks!
